content.title: Source-specific warm memo payloads and grown descendant domains remain the model gap
content.text: At published formalize8154da8, the frozen warm audit finds an existing general engine: SourceQueryInduction.query_returned_and_raw_results supports arbitrary inherited checked state, both memo tables and all endpoint/raw-count cases. The current source M-finish proof additionally needs four body-first/coherent/Top auxiliary Returned clauses. Its two authentic-inner producers require complete-empty initialization, and current Frame does not expose the inherited payload laws. Derive those source facts and authentic new-query qualification; another generic engine does not close this gap. Separately, the actual accepted initializer has ValueFields, so the original root is Empty or an ordinary node, and every Mu stored in the original source heap is the productive allTypes universe. This excludes a handcrafted unproductive-Mu startup counterexample. Actual grown descendant domains still need same-trace only-U, Normal and UnionNormal provenance. One compatible finite completion satisfying all removed historical obligations remains unproved. Exact existing headers, source pins and positive/negative boundaries are archived in 20261116-real-callback-and-isolation-checkpoint, from the warm-cm-query-preservation-audit and source-startup-recursive-inhabitance-audit-draft packets. No Haskell defect is established.
